name: Revenue mix
prompt: Revenue mix: MRR by industry, region and plan, plus seats and accounts across the book.

binding.sql: SELECT industry AS industry, ROUND(SUM(mrr),0) AS mrr FROM churn_risk GROUP BY industry ORDER BY mrr DESC

copy.title: MRR by industry
copy.caption: Fintech leads MRR, but the five industries sit within about $13K of one another.

binding.sql: SELECT region AS region, ROUND(SUM(mrr),0) AS mrr FROM churn_risk GROUP BY region ORDER BY mrr DESC

copy.title: MRR by region
copy.caption: The four regions each contribute close to a quarter of total MRR.

binding.sql: SELECT plan AS plan, ROUND(mrr,0) AS mrr FROM mrr_by_plan ORDER BY mrr DESC

copy.title: MRR by plan
copy.caption: Plan revenue is tightly clustered, led narrowly by Starter.

binding.sql: SELECT region AS region, SUM(seats) AS seats FROM churn_risk GROUP BY region ORDER BY seats DESC

copy.title: Seats by region
copy.caption: Seat distribution mirrors revenue — balanced across regions.

binding.sql: SELECT industry AS industry, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM churn_risk GROUP BY industry ORDER BY accounts DESC

copy.title: Accounts by industry
copy.caption: Each industry holds 120 accounts — an evenly diversified book.
